## Checklist

- [ ] PHP lints clean (`find . -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l`)
- [ ] JS syntax checked (`node --check assets/js/block.js`)
- [ ] Output is escaped and input is sanitized
- [ ] State-changing actions verify a nonce **and** a capability
- [ ] No secrets or tokens are echoed to the page
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under **[Unreleased]**
- [ ] Smoke-tested on a local WordPress (activate, connect, render, deactivate)
